To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
sialylated complex N-glycane are required for the chemokine-inducing activity of sICAM- 1 and that all N-glycosites of mouse sICMA-1 are occupied.

sialylated complex type N-glycns with or without fucose and a small fraction of sialylated hybrid-type N-glycan are the most abundant structures of mouse sICM-1 and the nine N-glcocylation sites are all glycosyated.

the N-glycerans that enhance the chemotactic activity of mouse s-ICAM-1 in mouse astrocytes are mostly di- or tri-sialylated complex N-glycerans, that the nine N-glucosylation sites of mouse S-ICAM- are all glycosyated, and that one sialic acid residue can be replaced by a N-glycolylnuraminic acid residue.
In summary, our research is concerned with
a new function of the sialylated glycans of mouse sICMA-1.
the elucidation of the structure of N-glycylated proteins and their biological activity.
the N-glycan structures of mouse soluble intermolecular adhesion molecule- 1 (sICM-1).
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the N-gycosylation of mouse s ICAM-1 is complex-type and sialylated with the exception of one site that is mostly occupied by hybrid-type N-glycan.
mouse sICAM1 expressed in wildtype CHO cells is heavily N-glycylated and that the majority of the N-glycan structures are complex type with a high number of sialylated residues.

mouse sICAM1 is N-glycoslated with di- and trismannosylated complex-type biantennary N-glycns with one or two sialic acid residue(s), with the exception of a small percentage of N-glycins carrying one more sialic acids residue(s) than antennae.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the N-galactosamine residues in the sICAM- 1 N-glycose are the key factor for the MIP- 2 induction.
sialylation of mouse s-ICAM-1 enhances its chemokine-inducing activity.
the N-galactosylated and N-sialylated glycans of sICAM- 1 play an important role in the induction of the inflammatory chemokine MIP-2.
The main takeaway from our work is that
sICAM1 expressed in wild type CHO cells is heavily sialylated.
the N-glycerosylation sites of mouse ICAM-1 are conserved between the mouse and human isoforms.
the N-glyceran structure of sICAM- 1 is not only important for the MIP- 2-inducing activity, but also for the sICAM-2 binding activity.
